info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Lease Update API
info.description: The Corporate Lease Update API enables businesses to modify existing corporate lease agreements efficiently. This endpoint supports operations to update specific lease details, ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance. Typical consumers include finance teams, leasing managers, and integrators who manage corporate leasing systems. By providing a streamlined approach to updating lease information, this API enhances operational efficiency and improves data accuracy across business applications.

patch.description: This endpoint allows authorized users to update the details of a specific corporate lease identified by its resource ID. Ensure that all required fields are provided to successfully process the update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the specified corporate lease details of a deposit lending operation. It contains all required fields that need to be updated in the corporate lease object, represented in JSON format.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
